svg.text: custom-pdm enclosure layout - PROPOSAL (2D plan, top view)
ILLUSTRATION generated by tools/gen_enclosure_layout.py from the board files + TE / Wuerth data. Not approved, not a source of truth. Placement margins are assumptions (open questions).
Inner plan about 314 x 261 mm (boards flat on one base plate / heat sink; heights not shown). North = top of the page = top of the board renders.
JST GH cables (input board J1 > board J6 / J7)
bottom mask window (bare +12 V copper, gap pad)
Pedestal margin 1.5 mm and rail width are placeholders. Blue dashed = proposed heat-sink pedestals, yellow = bottom mask windows (bare +12 V copper), red = switch pads,
orange dots / dotted box = J3 pin tails and the sink pocket, grey dashed = DT15 housing envelope with its four feet. Insulating gap pad goes between each window and its pedestal.
